name: Player Saving and Desert Return Portal

changes.name: SkyboundDataSave
changes.source:
local DSS=game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local store=DSS:GetDataStore("SkyboundPlayerData_v1")
local function save(p)
 local stats=p:FindFirstChild("leaderstats");local coins=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins")
 if not coins then return end
 local pets={};local folder=p:FindFirstChild("Pets")
 if folder then for _,v in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do if v:IsA("StringValue") then table.insert(pets,v.Value) end end end
 local data={coins=coins.Value,pets=pets,waterfall=p:GetAttribute("WaterfallUnlocked")==true,desert=p:GetAttribute("DesertUnlocked")==true}
 local ok,err=pcall(function() store:SetAsync("Player_"..p.UserId,data) end)
 if not ok then warn("Skybound save failed for "..p.Name..": "..tostring(err)) end
end
local function load(p)
 local ok,data=pcall(function() return store:GetAsync("Player_"..p.UserId) end)
 if not ok or type(data)~="table" then return end
 local stats=p:WaitForChild("leaderstats",10);local coins=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins")
 if coins and type(data.coins)=="number" then coins.Value=data.coins end
 p:SetAttribute("WaterfallUnlocked",data.waterfall==true);p:SetAttribute("DesertUnlocked",data.desert==true)
 local pets=p:FindFirstChild("Pets") or Instance.new("Folder");pets.Name="Pets";pets.Parent=p
 for _,name in ipairs(data.pets or {}) do local v=Instance.new("StringValue");v.Name=name;v.Value=name;v.Parent=pets end
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p) task.spawn(load,p) end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(save)
task.spawn(function() while true do task.wait(60);for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(save,p) end end end)
game:BindToClose(function() for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(save,p) end task.wait(3) end)

changes.name: DesertReturnPortalSystem
changes.source:
local portal=workspace:WaitForChild("SkyboundMap"):WaitForChild("DesertTemple"):WaitForChild("ReturnPortal")
local prompt=portal:WaitForChild("TravelPrompt")
local destination=workspace.SkyboundMap.WaterfallIsles:WaitForChild("IslandTop")
prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
 local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if root then root.CFrame=CFrame.new(destination.Position+Vector3.new(0,7,0)) end
end)
